title: EU Enlargement Commissioner Kos: Ukraine Cluster 1 Talks Must Open Before June 30 — All Six Clusters Ready
detail: EU Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos stated on May 17 that the formal opening of Cluster 1 ('Fundamentals') in Ukraine's EU accession negotiations must happen before June 30, 2026 — the end of the Cyprus Presidency — reaffirming the political commitment to advance Ukraine's candidacy. The Commission has confirmed all six accession clusters are technically ready for formal negotiation, following the completion of informal screening in March 2026. Ukraine has set May 26 as its target date for the Cluster 1 vote in the Council, which — following Hungary's pro-EU pivot under PM Péter Magyar — is expected to be unanimous. The Commissioner also noted that negotiations should proceed in parallel with institutional reforms that allow the EU to absorb new members, including potential Qualified Majority Voting extensions for certain Council decisions. The remarks framed the week ahead as critical for the momentum of the EU's largest-ever enlargement process since the 2004 Eastern wave.
